title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The bulk narrowing could write `private default`, which no version of Java accepts, into a file the user never opened.

highlights.title: Narrowing no longer breaks a Java interface
highlights.description: A `default` method is a public interface method with a body, so `private default` is refused by javac. The list that makes the narrowing give up held only `open`, `abstract` and `sealed`, all three Kotlin.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Make Every Self Only Member Private could write `private default String x()`. The command edits files the user never opened, so the first sign of it would have been a broken build.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: All 171 narrowings offered on the 6329 source project are unchanged, compared one by one before and after.
The cascade that removes the imports a deletion orphans had no witness of any kind. It has one now: 100 import cuts and 54 file deletions, every one of them holding.
